overview.en: This chapter explains how the body holds pH at 7.35-7.45 using buffers, lungs, kidneys and potassium shifts, then covers the four primary acid-base disorders, their causes, signs and nursing care. It ends with ABG collection and the step-by-step method for interpreting ABGs, a staple of NCLEX questions.
overview.zh: 本章說明身體如何以緩衝系統、肺、腎與鉀離子移動將 pH 維持在 7.35-7.45,並介紹四種原發性酸鹼失衡的原因、徵象與護理處置,最後說明動脈血氣(ABG)採檢與逐步判讀法,這是 NCLEX 的常考重點。

points.en: Blood pH must stay between 7.35 and 7.45; below is acidosis, above is alkalosis.
points.zh: 血液 pH 須維持在 7.35-7.45;低於此為酸中毒,高於此為鹼中毒。

points.en: Acids donate hydrogen ions and are end products of metabolism; bases accept hydrogen ions.
points.zh: 酸是氫離子的提供者,為代謝終產物;鹼是氫離子的接受者。

points.en: Normal serum bicarbonate (HCO3-) is 21-28 mEq/L.
points.zh: 血清碳酸氫根(HCO3-)正常值 21-28 mEq/L。

points.en: Buffers act fastest, giving immediate protection against pH change; once used up the body has less reserve.
points.zh: 緩衝系統反應最快,能立即防止 pH 改變;用盡後身體的儲備就減少。

points.en: Extracellular buffers: hemoglobin (chloride shift), plasma proteins, carbonic acid-bicarbonate (the main buffer) and phosphate.
points.zh: 細胞外緩衝系統包括血紅素(氯離子轉移)、血漿蛋白、碳酸-碳酸氫鹽(主要緩衝系統)與磷酸鹽。

points.en: Normal pH of 7.4 reflects a bicarbonate : carbonic acid ratio of 20:1; lungs control carbonic acid (CO2) and kidneys control bicarbonate.
points.zh: pH 7.4 代表碳酸氫根與碳酸比為 20:1;肺控制碳酸(CO2),腎控制碳酸氫根。

points.en: The underlying cause of any imbalance must be identified and treated.
points.zh: 必須找出並治療酸鹼失衡的根本原因。

points.en: Lungs are the second defense and respond in 10-30 seconds: in acidosis rate and depth rise to blow off CO2; in alkalosis they fall to retain CO2.
points.zh: 肺是第二道防線,10-30 秒內反應:酸中毒時呼吸加快加深以排出 CO2;鹼中毒時呼吸變慢變淺以留住 CO2。

points.en: Kidneys are slower (hours to days) but more thorough: they excrete H+ and retain HCO3- in acidosis, and excrete HCO3- in alkalosis.
points.zh: 腎臟反應較慢(數小時至數天)但更完整:酸中毒時排 H+、留 HCO3-;鹼中毒時排 HCO3-。

points.en: Potassium shifts: in acidosis H+ enters cells and K+ leaves, causing hyperkalemia; in alkalosis K+ enters cells, causing hypokalemia.
points.zh: 鉀離子移動:酸中毒時 H+ 進入細胞、K+ 移出,造成高血鉀;鹼中毒時 K+ 進入細胞,造成低血鉀。

points.en: Monitor potassium closely in any acid-base imbalance because of dysrhythmia risk.
points.zh: 任何酸鹼失衡都須密切監測血鉀,因有心律不整風險。

points.en: Caused by hypoventilation with CO2 retention: COPD/emphysema, asthma, pneumonia, atelectasis, pulmonary edema or emboli, brain trauma, and CNS depressants (opioids, sedatives, anesthetics).
points.zh: 因換氣不足導致 CO2 滯留:COPD/肺氣腫、氣喘、肺炎、肺不張、肺水腫或肺栓塞、腦外傷、中樞神經抑制劑(鴉片類、鎮靜劑、麻醉劑)。

points.en: Findings: lethargy, confusion, headache, dizziness, coma, hypotension, dysrhythmias (from hyperkalemia), warm flushed skin, seizures.
points.zh: 表現:嗜睡、意識混亂、頭痛、頭暈、昏迷、低血壓、心律不整(高血鉀所致)、皮膚溫熱潮紅、癲癇。

points.en: Care: O2 as prescribed, semi-Fowler's position, turn/cough/deep-breathe, suction, respiratory treatments; avoid sedatives; prepare for intubation and ventilation if CO2 is above 50 mm Hg with acute distress.
points.zh: 處置:依醫囑給氧、半坐臥、翻身咳嗽深呼吸、抽吸、呼吸治療;避免鎮靜劑;若 CO2 超過 50 mm Hg 且急性呼吸窘迫,準備插管與機械通氣。

points.en: Caused by overstimulated breathing: hyperventilation, anxiety, pain, fever, hypoxia, and over-ventilation by a mechanical ventilator.
points.zh: 因呼吸過度刺激:換氣過度、焦慮、疼痛、發燒、缺氧,以及呼吸器過度換氣。

points.en: Findings: light-headedness, dizziness, confusion, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, nausea/vomiting, numbness and tingling of extremities, tetany, hyperreflexia, seizures.
points.zh: 表現:輕飄感、頭暈、意識混亂、心跳快、心律不整、噁心嘔吐、四肢麻刺、手足僵直、反射亢進、癲癇。

points.en: Care: reassure, coach slow breathing, breath holding or rebreathing (paper bag/rebreather mask), adjust ventilator, calcium gluconate for tetany as prescribed.
points.zh: 處置:安撫、指導緩慢呼吸、閉氣或再吸入(紙袋/再呼吸面罩)、調整呼吸器,依醫囑給葡萄糖酸鈣治療手足僵直。

points.en: Causes: diabetic ketoacidosis, aspirin overdose, lactic acidosis, malnutrition, high-fat diet, renal failure, severe diarrhea (loss of alkaline fluid).
points.zh: 原因:糖尿病酮酸中毒、阿斯匹靈過量、乳酸中毒、營養不良、高脂飲食、腎衰竭、嚴重腹瀉(流失鹼性液體)。

points.en: Findings: lethargy, confusion, headache, hypotension, dysrhythmias, cold clammy skin, nausea/vomiting/diarrhea, and Kussmaul's respirations (deep, rapid).
points.zh: 表現:嗜睡、意識混亂、頭痛、低血壓、心律不整、皮膚冰冷濕黏、噁心嘔吐腹瀉,以及 Kussmaul 呼吸(深快)。

points.en: Care: IV fluids and buffer base, monitor I&O and electrolytes; in DKA give insulin and fluid resuscitation; in kidney disease dialysis and a low-protein, high-calorie diet.
points.zh: 處置:靜脈輸液與補充緩衝鹼、監測輸出入量與電解質;DKA 給予胰島素與輸液復甦;腎病則透析並採低蛋白高熱量飲食。

points.en: Causes: excessive vomiting or NG suction (loss of HCl), diuretics, hyperaldosteronism, excess sodium bicarbonate, massive whole-blood transfusion (citrate becomes bicarbonate).
points.zh: 原因:大量嘔吐或鼻胃管抽吸(流失鹽酸)、利尿劑、高醛固酮症、碳酸氫鈉過量、大量輸入全血(檸檬酸轉為碳酸氫鹽)。

points.en: Findings: dizziness, irritability, confusion, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, nausea/vomiting, tetany, tremors, tingling, muscle cramps, seizures; breathing becomes slow and shallow.
points.zh: 表現:頭暈、易怒、意識混亂、心跳快、心律不整、噁心嘔吐、手足僵直、顫抖、麻刺、肌肉痙攣、癲癇;呼吸變慢變淺。

points.en: Care: IV fluids and medications to promote bicarbonate excretion, replace potassium as prescribed, monitor respiratory status.
points.zh: 處置:依醫囑給予靜脈輸液與藥物促進碳酸氫根排出、補充鉀,並監測呼吸狀態。

points.en: Normal ABG: pH 7.35-7.45; PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg; HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L; PaO2 80-100 mm Hg (venous pH 7.31-7.41, PvO2 40-50).
points.zh: ABG 正常值:pH 7.35-7.45;PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg;HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L;PaO2 80-100 mm Hg(靜脈 pH 7.31-7.41、PvO2 40-50)。

points.en: Perform the Allen's test before radial puncture to confirm ulnar collateral flow; positive means immediate flushing after releasing the ulnar artery.
points.zh: 橈動脈穿刺前先做 Allen 測試確認尺動脈側支循環;放開尺動脈後手掌立即變紅即為陽性。

points.en: Use a heparinized syringe, remove any air, press the site 5 minutes (10 if on anticoagulants), recheck the radial pulse, send on ice.
points.zh: 使用含肝素針筒、排除空氣,穿刺後壓迫 5 分鐘(使用抗凝劑者 10 分鐘),再確認橈動脈搏動,冰浴送檢。

points.en: Record temperature and O2 delivery on the lab form; note recent suctioning (within 20 minutes) or O2 changes.
points.zh: 檢驗單上註明體溫與給氧方式;留意 20 分鐘內是否抽痰或調整氧氣。

points.en: Step 1: pH low = acidosis, high = alkalosis. Step 2: if PaCO2 moves in the OPPOSITE direction to pH, it is respiratory. Step 3: if HCO3- moves in the SAME direction as pH, it is metabolic.
points.zh: 步驟 1:pH 低為酸中毒、高為鹼中毒。步驟 2:PaCO2 與 pH 方向「相反」則為呼吸性。步驟 3:HCO3- 與 pH 方向「相同」則為代謝性。

points.en: Step 4: a normal pH (7.35-7.45) means full compensation; if pH is abnormal, check the other indicator: abnormal value = partial compensation, normal value = uncompensated.
points.zh: 步驟 4:pH 回到 7.35-7.45 表示完全代償;pH 仍異常時,看另一指標:已異常為部分代償,仍正常為未代償。

points.en: Mixed disorders combine two problems (e.g., hyperventilation from pain plus gastric suction gives mixed alkalosis).
points.zh: 混合性失衡為同時存在兩種問題(如疼痛致換氣過度加胃管抽吸造成混合性鹼中毒)。

points.en: Potassium is usually increased in acidosis and decreased in alkalosis.
points.zh: 酸中毒時鉀通常上升,鹼中毒時鉀通常下降。

critical_points.en: Normal ABG: pH 7.35-7.45, PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg, HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L, PaO2 80-100 mm Hg.
critical_points.zh: ABG 正常值:pH 7.35-7.45、PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg、HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L、PaO2 80-100 mm Hg。

critical_points.en: Respiratory indicator is PaCO2; metabolic indicator is HCO3-.
critical_points.zh: 呼吸指標是 PaCO2;代謝指標是 HCO3-。

critical_points.en: Respiratory imbalance: pH and PaCO2 move in opposite directions. Metabolic imbalance: pH and HCO3- move together.
critical_points.zh: 呼吸性失衡:pH 與 PaCO2 方向相反。代謝性失衡:pH 與 HCO3- 方向一致。
完全代償 = pH 回到 7.35-7.45。

critical_points.en: Respiratory acidosis: pH low, PaCO2 high. Respiratory alkalosis: pH high, PaCO2 low.
critical_points.zh: 呼吸性酸中毒:pH 低、PaCO2 高。呼吸性鹼中毒:pH 高、PaCO2 低。

critical_points.en: Metabolic acidosis: pH low, HCO3- low. Metabolic alkalosis: pH high, HCO3- high.
critical_points.zh: 代謝性酸中毒:pH 低、HCO3- 低。代謝性鹼中毒:pH 高、HCO3- 高。

critical_points.en: Vomiting and NG suction cause metabolic alkalosis (HCl loss); severe diarrhea and DKA cause metabolic acidosis.
critical_points.zh: 嘔吐與鼻胃管抽吸造成代謝性鹼中毒(流失鹽酸);嚴重腹瀉與 DKA 造成代謝性酸中毒。

critical_points.en: COPD, hypoventilation and opioid/sedative overdose cause respiratory acidosis; avoid sedatives and opioids in these clients.
critical_points.zh: COPD、換氣不足與鴉片類/鎮靜劑過量造成呼吸性酸中毒;此類患者應避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類。

critical_points.en: Kussmaul's respirations (deep and rapid) are the lungs' compensation for metabolic acidosis such as DKA.
critical_points.zh: Kussmaul 呼吸(深而快)是肺對代謝性酸中毒(如 DKA)的代償。

critical_points.en: Acidosis raises serum K+ (hyperkalemia); alkalosis lowers it (hypokalemia). Watch for dysrhythmias.
critical_points.zh: 酸中毒使血鉀上升(高血鉀);鹼中毒使血鉀下降(低血鉀)。須留意心律不整。

critical_points.en: Lungs compensate in 10-30 seconds; kidneys take hours to days but are more complete.
critical_points.zh: 肺代償需 10-30 秒;腎臟需數小時至數天,但更完整。

critical_points.en: Intubation/ventilation needed in respiratory acidosis when CO2 exceeds 50 mm Hg with acute respiratory distress.
critical_points.zh: 呼吸性酸中毒若 CO2 超過 50 mm Hg 並有急性呼吸窘迫,需準備插管與通氣。

critical_points.en: Do an Allen's test before radial ABG puncture; after puncture hold pressure 5 min (10 min if anticoagulated).
critical_points.zh: 橈動脈採 ABG 前先做 Allen 測試;穿刺後壓迫 5 分鐘(使用抗凝劑 10 分鐘)。

critical_points.en: Treat the underlying cause of every acid-base disorder and monitor level of consciousness, electrolytes and repeat ABGs.
critical_points.zh: 每種酸鹼失衡都要治療根本原因,並監測意識程度、電解質與追蹤 ABG。

critical_points.en: Hyperventilation from anxiety, pain or fever causes respiratory alkalosis; rebreathing (paper bag) and calm coaching help.
critical_points.zh: 焦慮、疼痛或發燒造成的換氣過度導致呼吸性鹼中毒;可用再吸入(紙袋)與安撫指導呼吸。

mnemonics.en: ROME: Respiratory Opposite, Metabolic Equal (pH vs PaCO2 opposite = respiratory; pH vs HCO3- same direction = metabolic).
mnemonics.zh: ROME 口訣:呼吸性相反(Respiratory Opposite)、代謝性相同(Metabolic Equal)。pH 與 PaCO2 相反為呼吸性;pH 與 HCO3- 同向為代謝性。

mnemonics.en: Tic-Tac-Toe ABG: place pH, PaCO2, HCO3- in a row and check which one matches the pH direction.
mnemonics.zh: ABG 判讀三格法:把 pH、PaCO2、HCO3- 排成一列,看哪一個與 pH 的方向吻合(酸中毒:pH 低,PaCO2 高 = 呼吸;HCO3- 低 = 代謝)。

mnemonics.en: Vomiting = alkalosis (lose acid); diarrhea = acidosis (lose base).
mnemonics.zh: 嘔吐=鹼中毒(失酸);腹瀉=酸中毒(失鹼)。

stem.en: ABG: pH 7.45, PaCO2 30 mm Hg, HCO3- 20 mEq/L. Which interpretation is correct?
stem.zh: ABG:pH 7.45、PaCO2 30 mm Hg、HCO3- 20 mEq/L。下列判讀何者正確?

rationale.en: pH is at the high-normal end with low PaCO2 (opposite direction = respiratory alkalosis). The low HCO3- shows renal compensation, and pH is normal so compensation is full.
rationale.zh: pH 在正常偏高,PaCO2 低(與 pH 相反 = 呼吸性鹼中毒);HCO3- 偏低顯示腎臟代償,pH 已正常故為完全代償。

stem.en: A client with a nasogastric tube to low suction is at risk for which disorder?
stem.zh: 鼻胃管接低壓抽吸的患者有發生哪種失衡的風險?

rationale.en: Gastric suction removes hydrochloric acid, raising pH and bicarbonate.
rationale.zh: 胃抽吸移除鹽酸,使 pH 與碳酸氫根上升。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with DKA has deep, rapid respirations. ABG: pH 7.20, PaCO2 28 mm Hg, HCO3- 12 mEq/L. Which interpretation and explanation are correct?
stem.zh: DKA 患者呼吸深快。ABG:pH 7.20、PaCO2 28 mm Hg、HCO3- 12 mEq/L。下列判讀與說明何者正確?

options.en: Respiratory alkalosis; the client is anxious
options.zh: 呼吸性鹼中毒;患者焦慮

options.en: Metabolic acidosis, partially compensated; the lungs are blowing off CO2
options.zh: 代謝性酸中毒,部分代償;肺正在排出 CO2

rationale.en: pH and HCO3- are both low (metabolic acidosis). PaCO2 is low, meaning the lungs are compensating (Kussmaul's), but pH is still abnormal so compensation is partial.
rationale.zh: pH 與 HCO3- 皆低(代謝性酸中毒);PaCO2 低表示肺在代償(Kussmaul 呼吸),但 pH 仍異常,屬部分代償。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: ABG results show pH 7.50 and PaCO2 30 mm Hg. Which manifestations does the nurse expect? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: ABG 顯示 pH 7.50、PaCO2 30 mm Hg。護理師預期有哪些表現?(複選)

rationale.en: This is respiratory alkalosis (hyperventilation): neuro, GI and cardiac excitation, with hypokalemia (not hyperkalemia).
rationale.zh: 此為呼吸性鹼中毒(換氣過度):出現神經、腸胃與心臟興奮表現,且為低血鉀而非高血鉀。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: An unresponsive client has pH 7.12, PaCO2 90 mm Hg, HCO3- 22 mEq/L. What is the interpretation?
stem.zh: 一位無反應患者:pH 7.12、PaCO2 90 mm Hg、HCO3- 22 mEq/L。判讀為何?

rationale.en: Low pH with high PaCO2 is respiratory acidosis. HCO3- is still normal and pH is abnormal, so the kidneys have not compensated.
rationale.zh: pH 低、PaCO2 高為呼吸性酸中毒;HCO3- 仍正常且 pH 異常,代表腎臟尚未代償。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which client is at greatest risk for respiratory acidosis?
stem.zh: 下列哪位患者最容易發生呼吸性酸中毒?

options.en: A client with several fractured ribs and shallow breathing
options.zh: 多根肋骨骨折且呼吸淺的患者

options.en: A client with a panic attack

rationale.en: Painful rib fractures cause hypoventilation and CO2 retention. Diarrhea gives metabolic acidosis, vomiting metabolic alkalosis, panic respiratory alkalosis.
rationale.zh: 肋骨骨折疼痛造成換氣不足與 CO2 滯留。腹瀉為代謝性酸中毒、嘔吐為代謝性鹼中毒、恐慌為呼吸性鹼中毒。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Before a radial ABG draw, the nurse performs an Allen's test. Which result allows radial puncture?
stem.zh: 橈動脈採 ABG 前進行 Allen 測試。何種結果可進行橈動脈穿刺?

options.en: The hand stays pale after the ulnar artery is released
options.zh: 放開尺動脈後手掌仍蒼白

options.en: The hand flushes immediately after the ulnar artery is released
options.zh: 放開尺動脈後手掌立即變紅

options.en: The hand flushes only after 30 seconds

rationale.en: Immediate flushing means ulnar collateral flow is adequate (positive test). If negative, test the other arm or choose another artery.
rationale.zh: 立即變紅表示尺動脈側支循環足夠(陽性)。若陰性,改測另一手臂或選其他動脈。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client on a ventilator has pH 7.50 and PaCO2 30 mm Hg. Which lab value is most likely?
stem.zh: 使用呼吸器的患者 pH 7.50、PaCO2 30 mm Hg。最可能出現哪項檢驗值?

rationale.en: Alkalosis drives K+ into cells, causing hypokalemia. The other values are normal.
rationale.zh: 鹼中毒使鉀進入細胞而造成低血鉀;其他數值皆在正常範圍。

cells.zh: 換氣不足（COPD、鴉片類、中樞抑制劑）
